rca_of_the_issue: Mini-map not displaying was caused by: 1) Backend returning 302 redirect instead of actual image bytes (React Native Image component doesn't follow redirects) - FIXED by proxying image bytes with 200 status. 2) Parent container having alignItems:center was causing image to be centered with 0 width - FIXED by removing alignItems:center from mapContainer styles.
